sanskrit:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः।
दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्।।
caption:
Chapter 11, Verse 20

Arjuna describes the scope. ‘dyāv-ā-pṛthivyor idam antaraṁ hi’ (Although You are one, You spread throughout the sky and the planets and all space between). ‘vyāptaṁ tvayaikena diśaś ca sarvāḥ’. ‘dṛṣṭvādbhutaṁ rūpam ugram tavedaṁ’ (O great one, seeing this wondrous and terrible form). ‘loka-trayaṁ pravyathitaṁ mahātman’ (All the planetary systems are perturbed). It is ‘Adbhutam’ (wonderful) but ‘Ugram’ (terrible). The demigods watching from other planets are terrified. The peace of the cosmos is disturbed by this revelation of raw power.
